Calculate Mobile Phone Output Power during WiFi Use

mpd_pwr_wifi.Rd

Calculates the mean output power of the mobile phone during WiFi use

Usage

mpd_pwr_wifi(
  band,
  duration_low,
  duration_lowmed,
  duration_medhigh,
  duration_high,
  params = load_params()
)

Arguments

band

WiFi frequency band ("2" for 2.4 GHz, "5" for 5.0 GHz)

duration_low

Duration (in seconds per day) of low output power activities

duration_lowmed

Duration (in seconds per day) of low-medium output power activities

duration_medhigh

Duration (in seconds per day) of medium-high output power activities

duration_high

Duration (in seconds per day) of high output power activities

params

Parameter list (optional). If not specified, calculations use default parameters.

Value

Output power in mW, including the duty cycles

Details

The output power depends on the frequency band (2.4 GHz or 5.0 GHz) and the type of activity:

$$P = P_{wifi} \times \sum_{k} q_{k} \times DC_{k}$$

where \(P_{wifi}\) is the output power of the band in mW, \(q_{k}\) the share of the activity \(k\) in the use time (see act_pwr_props()) and \(DC_{k}\) its duty cycle.

Examples

mpd_pwr_wifi(
band             = "2",
duration_low     = 4860,
duration_lowmed  = 540,
duration_medhigh = 4860,
duration_high    = 540)
#> [1] 10.0512
